title: Outlook on the web: tenant default for using commas to separate recipients
summary: The briefing passes: the tenant-wide PowerShell control, default behaviour and Exchange Online licensing description are supported. The updated Government Cloud release notes retain the cited delimiter-setting description; the briefing correctly leaves policy precedence and new Outlook tenant-default coverage open.

claims.where: What's changing; controls[0].governs; Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: RecipientDelimiters specifies the organisation-wide default for the Mail Compose and Reply comma-recipient setting.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Set-OrganizationConfig -RecipientDelimiters $false sets the tenant default so commas do not separate recipients.
claims.quote:
Set-OrganizationConfig
[-RecipientDelimiters <Boolean>]
$false: Commas aren't used to separate recipients by default.
